reviews.title: Just a Sales Funnel
reviews.text:
1- Too many sales emails
2- Too many ads within app 
3- No customer service 
4- Everything is old
5- political emails


I joined thinking it would be this great space, but it’s mostly a sales page constantly pitching you to spend more money, you can’t filter to only see what you have access to… because it’s actually a funnel. 

I saw upcoming live events so I stayed, excited for something live, 99% is old static programs, only to find out they aren’t adding anything new and burry that fact deep within the landing page… so, if you can show up live for four hours straight great, otherwise too bad.

Since joining I’ve received sales emails nearly every day, or emails that are “America sucks” and “trust AI”…  heavily politically driven which doesn’t feel aligned with the space or who they claim to be. 

If you decide to join, I’d really test the waters during the first two weeks so you know if you want to stay or cancel. 

Lastly, customer service is horrible, they don’t respond to emails and their chat support is 100% AI. 

I’ve canceled and don’t see myself returning after this experience.

reviews.text:
When in the app, I can watch the course previews and the first video of each lesson (usually very short)  on full screen without any problem but  as you are in the lesson and scroll down to the additional video for that lesson, which is always the full content, you cannot turn the phone for full screen to see the video. I have iPhone latest iOS updates and your app updates installed. 

I cannot push the typical [  ] icon/button for full screen because it is not there on the additional long videos within each lesson only the short intro to each lesson is Full screen capable, the only option is to screen mirror to another device. 

I’m currently in the Qi Gong courses. I’d like to watch all the content in the app on my iPhone on full screen.

I paid quite a bit for my subscription which is almost useless since I need to clearly see the body movement of the practitioner while I’m practicing. I would be too far from the phone to see anything in the tiny video window. 

I am finding it impossible to contact your company via the support option on the app. Can you please fix this or get a refund. Thx
